text: かたい　ハサミは　１まんばりきの　パワーを　もっているが　おおきすぎて　うごきが　にぶい。

structure.jp: １まんばりきの　パワーを　もっているが

patterns.name: 〜すぎる
patterns.explanation: すぎる added to a describing word says there is too much of it. おおきすぎて = 'being too big'.

patterns.name: 〜て (reason)
patterns.span: おおきすぎて　うごきが　にぶい
patterns.explanation: The て-form here gives the reason for what follows. おおきすぎて　うごきが　にぶい = 'they are too big, so its movements are sluggish'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が at the end of a sentence part means 'but'. もっているが = 'it has it, but'.
